name: Hoxhunt
summary: Hoxhunt sends employees short lessons and personalized phishing simulations that adapt as they improve. It lists 300+ training modules in video and text. No price is published: Hoxhunt prices per employee, and a quote follows a 30-minute scoping call that covers headcount, integrations and the capabilities needed.

facts.text: Product page: 300+ ready training modules in video and text are listed, plus interactive modules and several quiz formats.
Simulations are personalized by factors such as skill level, role and location, and the page says automation covers enrollment, reminders, completion tracking and manager escalations.
Compliance training tracks for PCI DSS, HIPAA, DORA and GDPR are listed on the page.
The scoping call covers challenges, employee count and integrations, a live view of the employee experience, and a tour of the administrator dashboard and reports.
